summary: The change adds a saved production/staging release channel. The channel selects the control-plane origin, the session file, and the update repository, and a "Use Staging" menu item switches it and relaunches the app. This round adds only `coverage-exempt` comments to main.ts, with the reason I accepted in round 2: importing main.ts starts Electron. The coverage gate now passes, all temp tests pass, and no findings remain.
